key_highlights: ASX slides lower amid Wall Street weakness from oil prices and rising bond yields; index limps through volatile week
CBA brings forward rate hike forecast, signalling tighter monetary path; RBA issues blunt warning ahead of next decision
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' with auction market facing reality check, pressuring REITs and property-linked equities
Iron ore prices under pressure ('roaches seethe'), weighing on BHP, RIO, FMG; gold projects (Forrestania, Aurum) offer relative strength
Odds of 2027 Australian recession rising; 'four horsemen' narrative for global economy intensifies
Super contributions surge >33% post-budget tax changes; government-backed digital pension scheme proposed as parallel to compulsory super
Consumer stress signals: Dollar General CEO flags red flags, Christmas retailer files Chapter 11, 80-yr discount chain closes 120 stores
LNG flows to Japan intensify as East Coast supply tightens; EV adoption accelerates, pressuring traditional fuel demand
Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman at 96, marking generational shift in global investing

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness pressures major miners; gold exploration (Forrestania 4 prefeasibility studies, Aurum Côte d'Ivoire high-grade discovery) provides offset. New blanket Safe Work rules criticised by miners as impractical, adding compliance cost risk.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from soft iron ore. Gold juniors (Aurum, Forrestania-linked names) attract speculative flows. Compliance costs may squeeze smaller miners.

sectors.trend: CBA brings forward rate hike forecast; RBA issues blunt warning pre-decision. Higher rates described as 'new normal.' Housing 'bloodbath' in Sydney threatens NPL trajectories.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from NIM expansion but face credit risk from property downturn. RBA hawkish tilt caps multiple re-rating. Super contribution surge supports fund managers (HUB.L, PPA.AX).

sectors.trend: Oil prices weigh on Wall Street and ASX energy names. Diesel/petrol shock rising domestically. LNG exports to Japan intensify amid East Coast supply constraints. EV adoption accelerates, structurally reducing fuel demand.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX face dual pressure from oil weakness and EV transition. LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) benefit from Japan demand. Fuel retailers (WES.AX, IGL.AX) squeezed by input costs.

sectors.trend: Sydney housing 'bloodbath' and auction market 'reality check' signal demand collapse. Rental market disruption via agent-bypass platforms. Short-stay shelter closures add social pressure.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Property developers (SRG.AX, CGP.AX) at risk. Rental-tech disruptors gain policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Consumer confidence deteriorating: Dollar General CEO raises red flags, Christmas retailer files Chapter 11, 80-year discount chain closes 120 stores. Temu IP theft pressures local brands.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, IGL.AX, LSG.AX face margin compression. Discount retailers under pressure. Local brands (e.g., Temu-affected labels) face IP and pricing challenges.

sectors.trend: CurveBeam among ASX runners of the week. AI concerns raised at Trump-Albanese talks. Activist group using AI to flood ABC with complaints. Coherent squeezes optical gear into plug-in module.
sectors.implications: CBE.AX (CurveBeam) shows small-cap momentum. AI regulatory risk could affect tech valuations. Optical/semiconductor supply chain (COHR) relevant to ASX tech supply chains.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: rate hike forecast brought forward, 'higher rates are the new normal' narrative
Housing market correction: Sydney bloodbath, auction reality check, rising NPL risk for banks
Commodity divergence: iron ore weak vs gold strength (Forrestania, Aurum)
Consumer stress: retail bankruptcies, discount chain closures, fuel cost shock
Super system reform: contribution surge, digital pension proposal, 'not fit for purpose' critique
Recession risk rising: 2027 odds increasing, 'four horsemen' global economy narrative
Energy transition: EV adoption accelerating, LNG export flows to Japan, fuel demand structural decline
Geopolitical: North Korea missile launches, US-Australia AI policy dialogue

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour floating-rate credit; hedge with AUD short. Monitor RBA statement language for forward guidance.
Underweight property developers and high-LVR REITs. Monitor bank NPL provisions. Diversify into healthcare and staples.
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold (A2M.AX, NGM.AX) and services. Watch China stimulus signals.
Increase cash and short-duration bonds. Favour defensive sectors (CSL.AX, WES.AX staples). Avoid cyclical overexposure.
Avoid discretionary retail; favour essential-staple retailers. Monitor retail sales data weekly.
Maintain gold allocation as hedge. Monitor defence stocks (WES.AX defence exposure, BUD.AX).

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and explorers amid safe-haven flows and high-grade discoveries
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 4 prefeasibility studies and Aurum Côte d'Ivoire high-grade gold signal sector upside; gold as hedge against recession and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Add to defensive healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Recession risk and consumer stress favour resilient cash-flow businesses; CSL remains ASX quality anchor

opportunities.recommendation: Selective bank exposure for NIM expansion, with credit-risk hedges
opportunities.rationale: CBA rate hike forecast supports NIM, but Sydney housing bloodbath caps upside; favour CBA over peers with lower property exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Monitor ASX small-cap momentum names (CurveBeam, Latrobe, Arrow, Sultan)
opportunities.rationale: Runners of the week signal speculative rotation; CurveBeam in tech/optics space aligns with AI infrastructure theme

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / thermal coal exposure; rotate to gold and LNG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'roaches seethe' signals sustained weakness; LNG to Japan provides structural demand support

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property developers and high-leverage REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney housing bloodbath and auction reality check signal falling valuations and rising vacancy risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash / short-duration bond allocation ahead of RBA decision
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA blunt warning and CBA rate hike forecast suggest further tightening; bond market repricing underway

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid discretionary retail and consumer cyclical names
defensive_moves.rationale: Chapter 11 filings, store closures, and consumer red flags indicate demand destruction

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. RBA rate decision and CBA-driven rate hike expectations cap equity multiples. Housing data deterioration and iron ore weakness weigh on financials and materials. Gold and defensives outperform. Expect elevated volatility (^AXJO range-bound with downside bias).
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Rising 2027 recession odds and 'four horsemen' narrative suggest a potential ASX correction. Structural themes: super reform (contribution surge, digital pension), EV transition, LNG export growth. Recovery contingent on China demand stabilisation and RBA pivot. Gold and healthcare offer relative strength.
